title: Formal gluing of finite commutative algebras
statement: Let $\varphi:R\to S$ be a flat homomorphism of commutative rings [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map], let $t\geq0$ and $f_1,\ldots,f_t\in R$, and put $K=(f_1,\ldots,f_t)$. Suppose the induced map $R/K\to S/KS$ is an isomorphism. Let $E^{\prime}$ be a commutative $S$-algebra and, for each $i$, let $E_i$ be a commutative $R_{f_i}$-algebra. Suppose there are algebra isomorphisms $\alpha_i:(E^{\prime})_{f_i}\xrightarrow{\sim}E_i\otimes_R S$ over $S_{f_i}$ and $\alpha_{ij}:(E_i)_{f_j}\xrightarrow{\sim}(E_j)_{f_i}$ over $R_{f_if_j}$, whose underlying modules and maps form an object of $\mathrm{Glue}(R\to S,f_1,\ldots,f_t)$ [def-weil-pbc-formal-glueing-data]. If $E^{\prime}$ is finitely generated as an $S$-module and every $E_i$ is finitely generated as an $R_{f_i}$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module], then there exists a commutative $R$-algebra $D$, finitely generated as an $R$-module, with algebra isomorphisms $D\otimes_R S\xrightarrow{\sim}E^{\prime}$ and $D_{f_i}\xrightarrow{\sim}E_i$ which together give an isomorphism from the canonical gluing datum of $D$ to the specified datum. In particular these algebra isomorphisms commute with all the $\alpha_i$ and $\alpha_{ij}$.
